The knowledge base has no matching document, so I’m searching the public web for the paper and its fish-bag calculation.
```python
web_result = await web_search('"Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon\'s Diet?" fish bag volume', max_results=5)
print(web_result)
```
I’m narrowing the search to the University of Leicester paper and the unit notation used for the volume.
```python
web_result_2 = await web_search('site:le.ac.uk "Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish" volume', max_results=10)
print(web_result_2)
```
I’m checking the paper’s likely repository or PDF record directly to verify the numerical value rather than relying on a snippet.
```python
web_result_3 = await web_search('"Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon\'s Diet" PDF', max_results=10)
print(web_result_3)
```
